01 / Your existing library

Keep originals in place.

Index a folder or sync your Lightroom catalogue through the bundled connector. Use existing Smart Previews through Lightroom, without copying your originals or building another cloud photo library.

02 / A thoughtful shortlist

Look beyond a score.

Search image content, named people, dates and camera metadata. Compare bursts, expression, composition, light and detail using actual previews. Your brief and preferences guide the choice.

03 / Lightroom renders

Edit, inspect, refine.

Adjust supported tone, colour, crop and detail controls on virtual copies. Review fresh Lightroom renders, recover through snapshots, and save the reviewed selection to a collection.

Built to avoid duplicate originals. A 256 MiB preview cache by default, about 947 MB of shared photo models once, and a compact local index. Lightroom’s own catalogue and AI data use additional space.

Source preview, outside the v0.2.0 installers. Global edits target Classic 14.2–15.6; AI masks require 15.6. Live macOS/Windows certification is pending. Advanced tools require a manual handoff. Previews requested by your agent are sent to that agent.

View source on GitHub Read the setup guide

Server or NAS · Docker required · optional alternative to desktop

git clone https://github.com/JeremySNR/Metachlorian
cd Metachlorian

METACHLORIAN_ADMIN_PASSWORD='choose-a-long-password' \
FOOTAGE_DIR=/path/to/footage \
  docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml up -d
Then open http://<host>:8765

Linux / macOS source · Python 3.11, uv, Node.js and FFmpeg

git clone https://github.com/JeremySNR/Metachlorian
cd Metachlorian/core
uv venv -p 3.11
uv pip install -e ".[analysis]"
.venv/bin/metachlorian models fetch
cd ../app && npm ci && npm run build
cd ../core
.venv/bin/metachlorian serve --add ~/Footage
Open http://127.0.0.1:8765

Before you press record

A few things
worth knowing.

Can I use Codex to edit photos in Lightroom Classic?

The current source preview adds photo search and an MCP editing workflow. Codex or another vision-capable agent compares actual previews, edits owned virtual copies through the bundled Lightroom connector, and reviews fresh renders before saving a collection. Global edits target Classic 14.2–15.6; AI masks require 15.6. Live Mac/Windows certification remains pending. These features are not in the v0.2.0 installers. Read the setup, storage and capability guide.

How do I install Metachlorian?

Download the Windows installer, macOS Apple Silicon disk image or Linux AppImage above. The app bundles its core dependencies and downloads about 1.7 GB of analysis models on first launch. Start with a small folder and wait for indexing and analysis before judging search results. Docker and source installations are also available.

What is Metachlorian?

Metachlorian is an open-source, self-hosted video library that indexes footage at shot level. It combines measured technical signals with AI models for meaning, so people and agents can search for specific moments across an archive.

Do I need a GPU or a cloud subscription?

No. The default models run locally on a CPU. A consumer GPU can accelerate processing and enable richer local vision-language captions. External providers are optional and must be enabled by an administrator.

Does it upload my footage?

Local and personal files are analysed locally unless an administrator enables a hosted model. Separately, new YouTube imports share machine metadata with a public community index by default, including possible titles, transcripts and on-screen text. Turn off Settings → Community sharing before importing private or unlisted videos. Video files and face identities are not contributed. Read the sharing details and opt-out.

Can I search for dialogue and specific people?

Yes. Hybrid search combines semantic similarity with words in transcripts, on-screen text, and labels. Faces can be recognised locally across shots and files; name someone once to find them again.

How does rights-aware search work?

You record licences, permitted uses, channels, territories, expiry dates and releases per file, with shot-level overrides. Search with an intended use to filter against those records. Metachlorian uses your recorded permissions; it does not determine legal ownership automatically.

Can I use it with my editor or AI agent?

Export selected footage through OpenTimelineIO, FCPXML or CMX 3600 EDL, or hand off a collection to Cutawan. Agents connect through MCP or the REST API, with read-only access by default and explicit scopes for exports and writes.

Is Metachlorian free and open source?

The source code is available under Apache 2.0. Model weights have their own licences, documented in the repository. Your hardware and any optional external provider may have costs.
